title: NightFeats: 面向文本生成赛道的情境优化多智能体RAG系统
summary: NightFeats 是一个结构化多智能体检索增强生成（RAG）系统，在 NeurIPS 2025 MMU-RAGent 竞赛中获得最佳动态评估奖。该系统将知识合成分解为检索、策展和组合三个阶段，引入时间语义重排序、有界矛盾协调和保留引用的组合等核心架构原语，在 LLM-as-a-Judge 和人类 Likert 评估中超越 Claude-SonnetV2 和 Nova-Pro 等专有基线。
summary_en: NightFeats is a structured multi-agent RAG system that won Best Dynamic Evaluation at NeurIPS 2025 MMU-RAGent. It decomposes knowledge synthesis into retrieval, curation, and composition phases, introducing temporal-semantic reranking, bounded contradiction reconciliation, and citation-preserving composition, outperforming proprietary baselines like Claude-SonnetV2 and Nova-Pro.
